summary_1line: The wind-god rebukes King Arjuna’s claim of Kshatriya superiority, recounting myths demonstrating the spiritual power and supremacy of Brahmanas.

image_candidates.scene_text: The wind-god speaks from the sky while the proud king Arjuna stands below, listening as the heavens warn him to bow before the Brahmanas.
The sage Angiras, blazing with ascetic power, drinks up all the waters of the world as if they were milk.
Kapila of golden radiance burns the sixty thousand sons of Sagara to ashes with the fire of his ascetic energy.
